title: GARM / Pools & Scale Sets
description: Capacity, provisioning latency and provider health per pool and scale set.

panels.title: Pool runners by instance status
panels.description: Instance states for the selected pools.

panels.title: Pool runners by runner status
panels.description: Forge-side runner states for the selected pools.

panels.title: Utilization vs max_runners
panels.description: How much of each selected pool's capacity is in use.

panels.title: Provider operations (selection)
panels.description: Successful provider operations per second for the selected pools and scale sets. The CreateInstance rate is the scale-up rate.

panels.title: Provider operation errors
panels.description: Failed provider operations by kind. timeout → hung provider binary or slow cloud; provider_error → the IaaS rejected the call.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, error_kind) (rate(garm_provider_operation_errors_total{pool_id=~"$pool", pool_id!=""}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(garm_provider_operation_errors_total{scaleset_id=~"$scaleset", scaleset_id!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Runner provision / ready time (p95)
panels.description: provision = cloud boot time; ready = until the runner can take jobs. The gap between them is userdata setup + runner registration.

panels.title: Runner lifecycle outcomes (selection)
panels.description: Why runners in the selected pools and scale sets are being removed. bootstrap_timeout points at a broken image/network/userdata; provider_error at the IaaS.

panels.title: Desired vs actual runners
panels.description: GitHub's requested runner count vs what actually exists. A persistent gap means scaling is stuck — check listener freshness and provider errors.

panels.title: Scale set messages
panels.description: Demand signal from GitHub. JobAvailable without matching JobAssigned means job acquisition is failing.

panels.title: Listener freshness
panels.description: Seconds since each scale set listener last completed a poll cycle. Anything over ~5 minutes has silently stopped receiving scaling signals.

panels.title: Listener restarts
panels.description: Unexpected listener exits. Flapping points at credential or network trouble with the message session.
